brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 2, Mr. Tumnus invites Lucy to tea in his cave. Build the tea, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about Lucy and Mr. Tumnus.
extra: Add an HTKAM - Literature Book for Mr. Tumnus’s shelf. Make up a title and say it.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the fire by a wall and the table near it. Add two chairs. Put the toast and cup on the table.
step4: Sit in a chair and say this out loud. Mr. Tumnus seems kind because… But he has a secret…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
